title: Norman and Arlene Selby's blackface Louis act
summary: After the Renaissance with Vernon Andrade, Zutty went to Philadelphia and Chicago with Norman and Arlene Selby, whose act had Norman impersonating Louis Armstrong on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: That's right. That's right, yes. And right after the Renaissance I went to Chicago. I went to Philadelphia with Norman and Arlene Selby. She used to do a Louise Cook dance and he made up black face.....
Yes. And he tried to do a Louis. See, and we went to Philadelphia and then we.....
Yes, yes. See, try to Charlie hit
those high notes like Louis, you know. A very neat act, it really was. Then we went to Chicago.
